First Time Smoking
I'm a 160lb male, 5'11. I decided to finally try smoking weed for the first time after my friends have been telling me how fun it is. So I Buy 7 grams of some medical marijuana from a guy my friend uses and here's my first experience.
06:00: I wake up, my parents and other siblings are still asleep, and go to my guest bedroom in the opposite corner of the house. I made a water bottle bong to smoke the weed in. I pack a fairly decent siezd bowl (approx. .4 grams) and smoked it as fast as I could.
06:10: It's been about 5-10 since my last hit and I don't feel anything, so I decide to pack another bowl (approx .5-.6 grams) and I take 2 hits. Still feeling nothing, I go in for another hit.
Still feeling nothing, I go in for another hit.
This time I hold it for as long as I can, allowing all of the THC to absorb into my body. As soon as I exhale, I feel this tingling sensation run from my feet, all the way up to my head. I fell onto the bed and laid there for what felt like an hour, but was only really 15 mins.
06:30: I check in the nearest mirror to see how my eyes looked and they were an intense dark red. I knew I needed to take eye drops, but I kept forgetting to. So I walk into my bedroom and lay in my bed. My head feels as if the room were spinning and my body was getting heavier by the minute.
07:00: I'm not a fan of being dizzy or nausious, so I started to feel kinda sick. Because I have a crippling fear of throwing up, I start to panic, and stupid ideas start to come into my head like, 'What if the weed is laced and I'm gonna die!?'.
07:05: I'm super panniced at this point and just want the high to be done. I walk into my parents room and tell them I feel like I'm going to throw up. They tell me to sit down and eat some food. So I sit on the couch and start to eat an apple.
07:15: Still feeling nauseous, I stand up too fast and kind of black out. When I stand back up, I feel a tingling in the back of my throat. I know exactly what is going to happen, so I start to panic, which only makes it worse. Then I start to throw-up all the liquid I had consumed that morning and my mom comes out to see if I'm okay. I tell her I'm fine and I sit back down on the couch
07:30: Taking advantage of the high now, I turn on adventure time and make myself some toast with peanut butter. I looked up why I may have thrown up
.
08:00: The effects are pretty much gone and I go back to sleep for another 2 hours
Overall Experience: Pretty Decent. I have smoked many more times afterwards, and have not thrown up since this time.
